entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David... I'm calling about my VeloBand. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for it and... well, it's not working.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's definitely a technical fault. I've charged it completely, but it just won't sync with the app. No matter what I try, it doesn't connect. I think the sensor inside might just be broken.
I see. It sounds very frustrating when a new device doesn't perform as expected. Do you have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Yes, it's under sarah.peters@email.com. I've been a loyal customer for a while now, and this is the first time I've ever had a defective product. Honestly, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 27th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It's just been sitting here because it's not working at all.

I completely understand, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. Looking at our policy, since the item is clearly defective and you received it just 28 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return period.
Oh, really? That's... that's a relief. So I can send it back for a refund?

Absolutely. There's no need for you to keep a broken item. I have just processed a return authorization for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email right now. Simply pack the band in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That is a huge weight off my shoulders. I really appreciate your help with this.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We want to make sure our customers are happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
